name: Asakura Akane
source: Biological older sister of the protagonist. She is one grade above him at the same school and an honor student. She gets many advances from the other male students at school but ignores them, however she is suspected of favoritism towards her brother.
translation: 主人公的亲姐姐。她比主人公高一年级，就读同一所学校，是优等生。她受到许多男同学追求，却都不予理会；不过，大家怀疑她对弟弟有所偏爱。
